name: Register a business, add stock and complete a sale
covers: 8-character minimum with uppercase lowercase number and special character
password visibility toggle and live strength meter
description: Proves the primary retail workflow persists sales and inventory movement.
steps: Create the first account with a valid name, email and password meeting all five password requirements
Add product SKU-A1 with barcode 10001, price 15, stock 8 and reorder level 3
Record a cash sale of 2 units
Open sales and stock movements, then refresh
expected: Registration accepts a compliant password, rejects a password missing any required character class, and the primary retail workflow persists sales and inventory movement.

name: Create a supplier and receive a purchase order
covers: Draft to Ordered to Received state transitions
receiving updates stock and stock movement ledger
description: Checks procurement records and the stock receipt lifecycle.
steps: Sign in as Managing Director
Add supplier North Star Supplies
Create a purchase order for 5 units of a product
Order the PO then receive it
Refresh inventory and purchase orders
expected: The PO reaches Received, inventory increases by 5 and an IN stock movement is recorded.

name: Role permissions deny unauthorized financial and team actions
covers: team member creation by Managing Director
Sales Agent cannot create expenses or products
team access disable and session rejection
description: Verifies permissions are enforced by backend routes, not only hidden controls.
steps: As Managing Director add a Sales Agent with a compliant password meeting all password requirements
Sign in as the Sales Agent
Attempt to add a product and record an expense
Disable the agent from the Managing Director account
expected: Unauthorized product and expense writes return 403, and disabled accounts cannot continue using the workspace.

name: Record an expense and issue an invoice
covers: report revenue expenses gross profit and receivables
description: Checks financial records feed management reporting and printable documents.
steps: Record a transport expense of 45 GHS
Create an invoice for a customer and 2 items at 20 GHS each
Print the invoice and mark it Paid
Open Reports and refresh
expected: Expense and invoice persist, invoice total is 40 GHS, paid invoice no longer contributes to receivables and report totals update.

name: Use barcode search and stock controls on mobile
description: Verifies core warehouse and sales tools remain usable on a phone.
steps: Sign in on mobile
Open Inventory and enter an existing SKU in the barcode search
Open Stock movements and adjust stock with a reason
Open Sales and print a receipt
expected: The product is found by SKU, stock adjustment is audited and the layout remains usable on a 375px screen.

name: Manage personal profile and account security
covers: update personal display name email and avatar URL
live password strength meter and rule checklist
description: Verifies personal account management remains available independently of business-role permissions.
steps: Sign in with a valid account and open the profile menu
Open My profile, update the display name and optionally an HTTPS profile image URL, then save
Confirm the updated name and avatar appear in the menu after refresh

Open Security, enter the current password and a new password of at least 8 characters containing uppercase, lowercase, number and special character; use visibility toggle and check the live strength meter
Sign out from the profile menu and confirm the sign-in screen appears
expected: Profile details persist, the avatar image or initials fallback displays correctly, password changes require the current password and all password complexity rules, the strength meter updates live, and logout clears the session.
